issue: Repeated impulse contacts when a parcel was trapped between moving blocks and floor; passing wins alone was not acceptance.
change: Relative body motion synchronized during impact; public one-impact paper rule: continue only through broken panels, otherwise fold/retire and let structures settle. Same mechanics and budget for every stage/input, no target deletion.
inputFix: Minimum-power high-angle drags were wrongly rejected by an unnecessary horizontal pull threshold; now any leftward legal pull is accepted.
stars: Normal policy wins all 16 at two stars; a separate ordinary 62 degree / 46 percent first-stage shot earns genuine three stars. A former test assumption that the normal policy must earn a full-star level was corrected; production star rules unchanged.
